Lab 3 Notes

Docstrings

The project uses Python docstrings on modules, classes, and functions. They are available through __doc__ and help() and can be read by Sphinx. Napoleon is enabled so the concise docstrings and parameter details are converted into readable Sphinx documentation.

Sphinx Workflow

From the project folder, install the documentation dependency if needed:

python -m pip install -r docs\requirements.txt

Build the HTML documentation with:

sphinx-build -b html docs docs\_build\html

The generated site is available at docs\_build\html\index.html. To rebuild from scratch, remove the build directory or run:

sphinx-build -M clean docs docs\_build
sphinx-build -b html docs docs\_build\html
